critical_escalations.delay_notes: Polymer resin adhesive shipment was delayed at the port, delaying carton gluing line.
critical_escalations.raw_transcript:
Agent: Hello, this is Alex calling from Enterprise Retail Logistics on a recorded line regarding Purchase Order PO-88120. Am I speaking with Maria Gomez for Pacific Packaging Solutions?
Supplier: Hello Alex, yes this is Maria Gomez.
Agent: I am calling to confirm delivery of PO PO-88120 for 25000 units of Heavy-Duty Corrugated Master Cartons (24x18x18), scheduled for delivery on 2026-09-15. Is this shipment currently on schedule?
Supplier: Unfortunately, no. We are behind schedule. Polymer resin adhesive shipment was delayed at the port, delaying carton gluing line.
Agent: I understand. What is the guaranteed revised delivery date at our receiving facility?
Supplier: Our updated target date is 2026-09-20. We can guarantee arrival on 2026-09-20.
Agent: Will there be any expedited freight surcharge or cost impact incurred to meet that date?
Supplier: We have authorized an expedited freight run which will cost $850.00 to accelerate transit.
Agent: Understood. Please provide the escalation supervisor contact managing this delay recovery.
Supplier: You can reach Maria Gomez directly at +1-555-014-9923.
Agent: Thank you Maria Gomez. I have logged the revised delivery date of 2026-09-20, the reason, and the escalation contact. We will follow up if further expedited routing is required. Goodbye.
Supplier: Thank you for your patience, Alex. Goodbye.
